Hotjar is now Contentsquare. Everything you know from Hotjar — heatmaps, recordings, and surveys — plus a lot more. What happened to Hotjar? Hotjar is now part of Contentsquare. The two platforms have merged into a single, more powerful experience intelligence platform. If you were looking to try Hotjar, Contentsquare is where you sign up — and you'll get a lot more for free. What is Contentsquare? Contentsquare is an experience analytics platform that helps you understand what your users are doing on your website or app — and why. It includes heatmaps, session replay, surveys, error monitoring, funnel analysis, and AI-powered insights, all in one place. Is Contentsquare free to use? Yes. Contentsquare has a free plan that includes 200k sessions per month, heatmaps, session replay, surveys, error monitoring, funnels, and 10+ integrations. You'll also start with a 15-day trial of the Growth plan — no credit card required. How does Contentsquare compare to what Hotjar offered? Contentsquare includes everything Hotjar was known for — heatmaps, recordings, surveys — plus a new set of capabilities like Attention Maps, Error Monitoring, Performance Monitoring, Funnels, and Sense AI. The free plan also captures 200k sessions per month, compared to 35/day on Hotjar's free plan. Your use of Contentsquare's Free plan is governed by Contentsquare's terms of service. Conversation Insights Understand what’s impacting customer experiences Use customer conversations to uncover what’s driving contact without waiting for survey feedback. See how shifts in sentiment, quality issues, and frustration levels impact revenue. Conversation Insights reveals the bigger picture of what customers are saying—so you can anticipate problems, improve products and processes, and reduce repeat contacts and churn. AI Agent Analytics Analyze how AI agents perform when trust is at stake Your AI agents are handling more customer conversations, but how are those conversations going? See where automation succeeds or falls short, and where customers need human support. AI Agent Analytics automatically tracks containment, transfers, abandonment, and sentiment, helping you improve prompts, guardrails, and escalation strategies. Conversation Intelligence in Product Analytics Spot friction and conversation volume spikes from a single dashboard See contact drivers directly inside Contentsquare’s Product Analytics. Connect what customers say to what they do, and quantify the revenue impact of specific issues. Use conversation insights to find impacted customers, build segments, and reach out to fix issues. This combined view of conversations and behavior reveals what’s happening, who it affects—and what it costs. Learn more Conversation Intelligence in Sense Analyst Combine behavior and conversation data in a single AI-powered analysis Skip the lengthy analysis and jump directly to the answers you need, with just a few prompts. Get easy, in-depth answers from both behavioral data and customer conversations. Sense Analyst connects the dots to make sense of conversion drops, error spikes, and more. Learn more Common use cases Use customer conversations to fuel growth, retention, and cost-efficiency Spot what’s driving demand, creating friction, or putting retention at risk. So you can take proactive, data-driven action instead of playing catch-up. Find where you can increase conversions and revenue with AI commerce agents Design AI agent experiences that resolve issues and guide customers through purchases. Use customer interactions to inform your AI agent strategy—from when agents reach out to which content customers see. Move from reactive to proactive AI automation with proven conversion insights. Know which conversations drive results, and scale them up to deliver the right engagement, at the right time, to the right customers. Top impact metric: Conversion rate Improve AI deflection without impacting the customer experience Get a fuller picture of your customer experience, including changes in sentiment, exchange patterns, and root causes of contacts. From here, planning your automation strategy is easy—understand which interactions AI can handle, which need human assistance, and where your AI agents need refinement. Jonathan started the company as a student project with a singular vision—to improve how people experienced the web.</p><p class>Businesses struggled to understand their customers’ online behavior, and had even less direction when it came to improving the experience. Driven by the desire to make the invisible visible, Jonathan set out to help brands gain deeper insights into their customers' needs and emotions during their online journeys.</p><p class>Determined to bring this vision to a global scale, Jonathan relocated to New York, where he expanded Contentsquare into the global company it is today. Contentsquare is established as a leader in the experience analytics space— having secured $1.4 billion in funding and made eight significant acquisitions.</p><p class>Despite this tremendous growth, With our flexible and scalable platform, you quickly get a deep understanding of your customers’ whole online journey. Our AI-powered insights provide those “ah ha” moments you need to deliver the right digital experiences. You get to work faster and smarter with the confidence to know what to do next to improve. When your customers receive an online experience they love, seek and deserve they’ll come back again (and again). And whatever your size, having the insights you need to deliver great experiences will transform your business. 1+ billion Behaviors analyzed Why choose Contentsquare You’re in good company Our insights are used to optimize experiences on over 1.3 million websites worldwide. One tool for everything You only need one tool as we have broad analytics all in one place. Data you can trust Our quantitative and qualitative data is the best in the business—it’s robust, private and secure. Our story Contentsquare was founded in 2012 by Jonathan Cherki. Jonathan started the company as a student project with a singular vision—to improve how people experienced the web. Businesses struggled to understand their customers’ online behavior, and had even less direction when it came to improving the experience. Driven by the desire to make the invisible visible, Jonathan set out to help brands gain deeper insights into their customers' needs and emotions during their online journeys. Determined to bring this vision to a global scale, Jonathan relocated to New York, where he expanded Contentsquare into the global company it is today. Contentsquare is established as a leader in the experience analytics space— having secured $1.4 billion in funding and made eight significant acquisitions. Despite this tremendous growth, the core of Contentsquare’s mission has remained consistent: to empower businesses to create a world where everybody has a digital experience they love, seek, and deserve—an experience that is accessible, inclusive, trustworthy and sustainable. Our timeline 2012 Contentsquare is founded in Paris 2016 $20M raised in Series A London office opens 2017 100th employee joins Offices open in NYC and San Francisco 2018 $42M raised in Series B 2019 $60M raised in Series C Acquisition of Clicktale and Pricing Assistant 2020 $190M raised in Series D Acquisition of AdaptMyWeb and Dareboost 2021 $500M raised in Series E Acquisition of Hotjar and Upstride Launch of The Contentsquare Foundation 2022 $600M raised in Series F 2023 Acquisition of Heap and PingPong 2024 New all-in-one platform created, bringing all Contentsquare, Heap and Hotjar products together in one place Meet our leadership team Management Jonathan Cherki Founder and CEO Rachel Obstler Chief Product Officer Marcela Martin Chief Financial Officer Jean-Christophe Pitié Chief Marketing Officer Patrick Chatain Chief Technology Officer Arnaud Gouachon Chief Legal and People Officer Costa Harbilas President, Go-to-Market Patrice Attia Chief Revenue Officer Board Nathalie von Niederhaeusern Managing Director at BlackRock Jonathan Cherki Founder and CEO Anne-Charlotte Philbert Managing Director at Eurazeo Growth Tony Zappala Partner at Highland Europe Michel Combes Independent Board Member Eduardo Sanchez Ex CEO of Rich Relevance Sumer Juneja Managing Partner and Head of EMEA & India Investing at SoftBank Group Benjamin Johnston Managing Director of Sixth Street Armelle de Madre Independent Board Member Hernán Asorey Independent Board Member Our investors Our values Be daring The biggest risk is no risk. We share an ambition and hunger inside that pushes us to go beyond together. Win or lose, we’re in it together. Be understanding Empathy is our superpower. We continuously improve by listening and learning from our customers, their customers, and each other. Be deliberate We eat data for breakfast. We’re deliberate in our approach and process, using data to guide our decisions so we can make the moves that count. Be simplifiers Ease at every opportunity. We’re all empowered to make the complex simpler—for our customers and each other. Careers at CSQ Want to help us create a world where everybody has a digital experience they love, seek, and deserve?
